name: The Queen’s Club
lede: The Queen’s Club renovated its outdoor terrace and opened it to about 100 more restaurant and bar guests, with white Tungsten Electric heaters for spring and late autumn.
data: Sports and members’ club – restaurant and bar terrace

hero.caption: Comparable Bromic installation, not this project: replace with project photography once licensed.

beats: The club’s outdoor terrace serves its restaurant and bar.
After a renovation, the terrace opened to about 100 more guests, who needed to be comfortable in the shoulder seasons.
White Tungsten Smart-Heat Electric heaters were chosen to suit the decor and the club’s tennis theme, so members can dine outside in spring and late autumn.
